kv_stream_lean_build.bench: KV streamer ot_hdc_kv_stream gate-level scan bench (7,187 scan cells), the bench the lean run generated, rebuilt on ot-pve1
kv_stream_lean_build.measured_with: a Python wrapper, since the worker image ot-host:22.04 has no /usr/bin/time: single = ru_maxrss of the largest child process, tree = summed RSS of the whole build process tree sampled each second
kv_stream_lean_build.failure_explained: the earlier lean run of this bench was admitted at a 16 GB floor on a 32 GB worker and cc1plus was killed for memory; the build needs about 24 GiB
kv_stream_lean_build.sizing_rule: with -j 4 the whole-tree peak is about twice the largest single compile unit (about 12 GiB here), and -fno-inline does not lower it; size the gate floor from the tree peak plus margin (32 GB for this bench), and measure a new bench's build before choosing its floor
